# Workbook fixtures

`missing-cache.xlsx` is synthetic test data generated by
`examples/excelize/main.go` with Excelize v2.11.0. Sheet `Sales` has one net sale
of 100 and two formulas (`C2 = B2*0.2`, `D2 = B2+C2`), neither with a saved result.
Expected report: one worksheet, two formula cells, two missing caches, no errors.

Regenerate with `go run .` inside `examples/excelize`, then copy the generated
`missing-cache.xlsx` here. Generation is optional and needs Excelize's dependencies;
normal checker tests are dependency-free.

`cached.xlsx` is the same synthetic workbook recalculated and saved by LibreOffice
26.2.6.3, using an isolated temporary profile. Its saved values are `C2 = 20` and
`D2 = 120`; expected report: two formula cells, zero findings. This fixture tests
cache presence, not a freshness guarantee.

Example regeneration (paths refer to separate temporary directories):

```sh
libreoffice -env:UserInstallation=file:///tmp/xlsxcache-lo-profile \
  --headless --convert-to xlsx --outdir /tmp/xlsxcache-recalculated \
  missing-cache.xlsx
```
